|strategy=By Tim Lau<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/duallasercannon.html</ref>

Are you like me, always having trouble taking out Walkers? Well look no furthur, this may not win every battle, but it sure makes the Dark Side think twice about Walkers. Use Dual Laser Cannons in combination with a [[Power Harpoon]]. Trip the Walker with the harpoon, now that the Walker's armor is 2, use Dual Lasers to finish it off. This method works well because the Dark Side has to lose everyone that is on board, and they might have trouble mounting an effective second strike. If they no longer have Walkers, use the [[Dual Laser Cannon]], preferably on [[Rogue 1]] or 3 with matching gunners, to shoot people who are camping outside.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-duallasercannon-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dual Laser Cannon (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018): Same words as the 2013 slip. This is a slip again: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title.

The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
